text: dsh-agy-staff 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Antigravity CLI 插件，通过 bundle 注册技能 provider、agy 子代理 provider 和浏览器控制面板。它提供快速问答、通用任务、调研、代码或方案评审、定向实现、任务编排与作业管理等技能，并可把任务作为子代理委派；面板可调整模式和模型、运行连通性测试、查看或取消作业。适合希望在 DSH 中调用 agy 处理研究、审查或实现工作的用户。需要安装 Node.js 与 agy CLI，并先完成 CLI 登录。

dsh-agy-staff adds Antigravity CLI skills, an agy subagent provider and a browser panel to DeepSeek Harness. Use it for questions, research, reviews, implementation and job management. The panel changes modes and models and shows or cancels jobs. Requires Node.js and a logged-in agy CLI.
想让 DSH 把调研、代码审查或小范围实现任务交给另一个模型处理。
有没有办法在对话里直接启动 Antigravity 子代理，并回来查看任务结果？
I want a second model to research a topic or review a plan from inside my DSH workflow.
dsh-agy-staff 的功能「按角色调用 agy 技能」：在 DSH 的技能菜单提供快速问答、通用任务、调研、评审、实现、编排和作业管理入口；用户选择技能并提交问题或任务后，由 provider 交付对应说明。
dsh-agy-staff 的功能「委派给 agy 子代理」：DSH 可把提示作为子代理请求交给 agy provider；调用按所选模式启动任务并返回作业结果，控制面板还可查看或取消作业。
dsh-agy-staff 使用前须知：委派需先安装并登录 Antigravity CLI；任务提示会作为参数传给 agy companion 执行。

dsh-agy-staff README · Introduction：

A DeepSeek Harness bundle that hires agy-staff's personas as seven skills — /agy-ask, /agy-staffer, /agy-researcher, /agy-reviewer, /agy-implementer, plus /agy-lead and /agy-jobs.

dsh-agy-staff README · Introduction：**[Why](#-why) · [Install](#install) · [Usage](#cujs) · [Core design](#core-design) · [Control panel](#control-panel) · [Updating](#updating) · [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting) · [Credits](#credits)**

dsh-agy-staff README · What & Why：[agy-staff](https://github.com/keli-wen/agy-staff) hires Google's Antigravity CLI (`agy`, Gemini 3.8 Flash) as staff: the host agent hands out a survey, a review, or a scoped implementation, and gets a second model family back in seconds instead of grinding the same work itself. It ships as plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Pi and OpenCode.

dsh-agy-staff README · What & Why：DeepSeek Harness is not one of those hosts. **dsh plugins are cordis bundles**, not host plugin manifests, and dsh has no `/agy:` namespace: its composer menu matches the skill *name* from frontmatter, discovered through a registered **skill provider**. So this repo is not an installer script that copies files around — it is a dsh bundle that registers one provider serving the vendored personas:

dsh-agy-staff README · What & Why：```
dsh-agy-staff (bundle patch)
  └── row: dsh-agy-staff  (inject: ['skills'])
        └── ctx.skills.registerProvider(...)
              └── /agy-ask  /agy-staffer  /agy-researcher  /agy-reviewer

Nothing is written into `~/.dsh/skills`, nothing is junctioned, and no upstream checkout is required at runtime: the personas, the companion and the reference docs ship inside the package under `assets/`.

dsh-agy-staff README · What & Why：| | Claude Code / Codex | DeepSeek Harness (this bundle) | |---|---|---| | Install | `claude plugin install …` | `dsh plugin --profile

add …` | | Surface | `/agy:ask` | `/agy-ask` | | Skill delivery | plugin manifest | `ctx.skills.registerProvider` | | Shared resources | `/companion` | `resourceBase` → `/assets/` | | Taking effect | next session | **restart the app** (bundles load at host start) | | Agent surface | not applicable | `agy` subagent provider + tool: delegate without a shell command | | Settings | host plugin settings | round **agy** panel: mode/model/effort/timeout, job list, live test |

dsh-agy-staff README · Install：**Step 1 — the worker.** Node.js and the [Antigravity CLI](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/install), logged in once:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh | bash
agy --version
```

On Windows the installer puts `agy.exe` under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\agy\bin`; keep that on `PATH`.

**Step 2 — install the bundle into a profile.** `dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm in the profile directory and registers the bundle in `dsh.profile.bundles`:

dsh-agy-staff README · Install：```powershell
git clone https://github.com/Adingo001/dsh-agy-staff.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:$PWD/dsh-agy-staff"
```

Or straight from GitHub, if you would rather not keep a clone:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:Adingo001/dsh-agy-staff"
```

**Step 3 — restart DeepSeek Harness.** A skill *directory* is picked up live; a new bundle row is not. Quit the app and open it again, then type `/agy` in the composer: seven rows.

dsh-agy-staff README · Install：**Step 4 — smoke test.** `ask` is tool-free, so it needs no setup and answers in about three seconds:

```powershell
node "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-agy-staff\assets\companion\agy-companion.mjs" ask --prompt "reply with OK"
```

dsh-agy-staff README · CUJs：| Use case | Type this |
|---|---|
| Quick second opinion | `/agy-ask what's your backend model` |
| General task | `/agy-staffer summarize the open TODOs in this repo` |
| Generate an image | `/agy-staffer generate a pixel-art robot mascot, save it as assets/mascot.png` |
| Review the working tree | `/agy-reviewer Review the current working tree` |
| Review a PR | `/agy-reviewer Review PR #12` |
| Challenge a plan | `/agy-reviewer Challenge the migration plan in docs/plan.md` |
| Survey a topic | `/agy-researcher how does auth work in this repo` |
| Scoped implementation | `/agy-implementer fix the flaky retry test` |
| Orchestrate a task | `/agy-lead investigate the options, draft a proposal, then revise it with my feedback` |
| Job ops | `/agy-jobs`, or just "is the agy job done?" |

dsh-agy-staff README · CUJs：Only `ask` blocks. The rest return a job id; the companion's `wait` collects the report, and in dsh you run that `wait` as a background command so the host keeps working — one wait per job, `exit 2` means still running.

dsh-agy-staff README · Core design：- **One provider, seven candidates.** `index.js` parses the vendored `assets/skills/<persona>/SKILL.md` frontmatter, serves the body as skill content, and reports `rank: 600` (the packaged-provider precedence). It has no dependencies — Node builtins only.
- **Name prefix is load-bearing.** dsh has no colon namespace; `/agy` only lists something if the *name* starts with `agy`. The bundle therefore serves `agy-<persona>` while the on-disk directory keeps upstream's `ask`/`jobs`, so `../jobs/SKILL.md` still resolves as written.
- **Every path is resolved before the model sees it.** Upstream writes `<skill-dir>/../../companion/agy-companion.mjs` and delegates the resolution to its host; under dsh that reads as a riddle, so the first run of every fresh session wasted a turn globbing for the companion and another one retrying. The provider now rewrites `<skill-dir>`, `<plugin-root>`, `../jobs/…`, `../../companion/…` and `../../docs/…` to absolute paths and prepends a "these are resolved, do not search" block. The command runs as written, first try, every time — the vendored bytes stay untouched.
- **`resourceBase` is still advertised.** `{ kind: 'direc

dsh-agy-staff README · Control panel：The bundle ships a small panel in the browser client (`dsh.client` → `client.js`, registered into the `shell.overlay` slot) and one host route to feed it: `POST /agy/api`. After a restart a round **agy** button sits above the composer.

dsh-agy-staff README · Control panel：| Panel section | What it does |
|---|---|
| 环境 | companion path (✓/✗), `agy --version`, plugin version, settings path |
| 委派配置 | mode (`staffer`/`research`/`review`/`implement`/`ask`), effort composed into the model id, a model family or a raw id, and the per-delegation timeout |
| 连通性测试 | one `ask` round trip with its wall time — the "is agy actually working" button |
| 作业 | recent jobs from `<cwd>/.agy-staff/state.json`, with **结果** and **取消** |

dsh-agy-staff README · Control panel：Every saved value is read per delegation from `<dshHome>/agy-staff/settings.json`, so **保存 takes effect on the next call, no restart**. Only the bundle rows (the panel itself, the tool, the providers) are fixed at app start.

The route is same-origin only: a cross-site request is rejected on `Origin`/`Sec-Fetch-Site`, and `content-type: application/json` is required, so a random page cannot drive agy through the loopback interface.

dsh-agy-staff README · Updating：Upstream moved:

```powershell
git -C <agy-staff-checkout> pull
node scripts/vendor-upstream.mjs --from <agy-staff-checkout>
npm test
```

Then restart the app. `scripts/vendor-upstream.mjs` copies the payload, rewrites `assets/UPSTREAM-COMMIT`, and warns when a path upstream dropped is missing.

This bundle itself:

```powershell
git pull
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:$PWD"   # re-link after a move
```

dsh-agy-staff README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `/agy` lists nothing | bundle row not loaded | check `dsh-agy-staff` is in the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`, then restart the app |
| Warning: duplicate skill `agy-ask` | an older filesystem install is still in `~/.dsh/skills` | delete `~/.dsh/skills/agy-*` (the bundle takes over) |
| `unknown subcommand: researcher` | companion modes are `research` / `review` / `implement` | call the mode, not the skill directory name |
| `ask` hangs or 401 | agy needs a localhost port plus its OAuth token | run it unsandboxed and log `agy` in once |
| Skill body's relative path 404s | `assets/` incomplete after a manual edit | re-run `node scripts/vendor-upstream.mjs` |
| Everything vanished after reinstall | the row id changed to a package name pnpm cannot resolve | `dsh plugin --profile desktop why dsh-agy-staff` |

Go star upstream; if you use this bundle you are using their work.

dsh-agy-staff README · Introduction：

一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件（bundle），把 agy-staff 的 personas 装成七个技能：/agy-ask、/agy-staffer、/agy-researcher、/agy-reviewer、/agy-implementer，外加 /agy-lead 和 /agy-jobs。

**[为什么 · 安装 · 用法 · 原理 · 控制面板 · 更新 · 排错 · 鸣谢](#为什么)**

dsh-agy-staff README · 为什么：[agy-staff](https://github.com/keli-wen/agy-staff) 把 Google 的 Antigravity CLI（`agy`，Gemini 3.8 Flash）雇成"员工"：主 agent 把一个调研、一次 review 或一段小范围实现交出去，几秒钟拿回另一个模型家族的结论，而不是自己啃同样的活。它给 Claude Code、Codex、Pi、OpenCode 提供了插件。

**DeepSeek Harness 不是这类主机。** dsh 的插件是 **cordis bundle**，不是宿主插件清单；dsh 也没有 `/agy:` 命名空间 —— 输入框的 `/` 菜单匹配的是 frontmatter 里的**技能名**，技能由一个注册进去的 **skill provider** 提供。所以这个仓库不是"把文件拷来拷去的安装脚本"，而是一个 dsh bundle，注册一个 provider 来供那七个 persona：

dsh-agy-staff README · 为什么：```
dsh-agy-staff（bundle patch）
  └── row: dsh-agy-staff  (inject: ['skills'])
        └── ctx.skills.registerProvider(...)
              └── /agy-ask  /agy-staffer  /agy-researcher  /agy-reviewer

不往 `~/.dsh/skills` 写任何东西，不建 junction，运行时也不需要上游 checkout：personas、companion 和参考文档都随包放在 `assets/` 里。

dsh-agy-staff README · 为什么：| | Claude Code / Codex | DeepSeek Harness（本 bundle） | |---|---|---| | 安装 | `claude plugin install …` | `dsh plugin --profile

add …` | | 调用面 | `/agy:ask` | `/agy-ask` | | 技能投递 | 插件清单 | `ctx.skills.registerProvider` | | 共享资源 | `/companion` | `resourceBase` → `/assets/` | | 生效时机 | 下一次会话 | **重启应用**（bundle 在宿主启动时加载） | | 智能体形态 | 无 | `agy` 子智能体 provider + 工具：不用拼 shell 命令也能派活 | | 设置 | 宿主插件设置 | 圆形 **agy** 面板：模式/模型/强度/超时、作业列表、在线自测 |

dsh-agy-staff README · 安装：**第一步 —— 干活的模型。** Node.js 和 [Antigravity CLI](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/install)，先登录一次：

```powershell
curl -fsSL https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh | bash
agy --version
```

Windows 上安装器会把 `agy.exe` 放进 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\agy\bin`，记得在 `PATH` 里。

**第二步 —— 装进 profile。** `dsh plugin` 会把参数转发给 profile 目录里的 pnpm，并把 bundle 登记进 `dsh.profile.bundles`：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/Adingo001/dsh-agy-staff.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:$PWD/dsh-agy-staff"
```

dsh-agy-staff README · 安装：不想留 clone 的话，直接从 GitHub 装：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:Adingo001/dsh-agy-staff"
```

**第三步 —— 重启 DeepSeek Harness。** 技能**目录**是热加载的，新 bundle 不是。退出应用再打开，然后在输入框打 `/agy`：七行。

**第四步 —— 冒烟测试。** `ask` 不碰工具，不用 setup，三秒出结果：

```powershell
node "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-agy-staff\assets\companion\agy-companion.mjs" ask --prompt "reply with OK"
```

dsh-agy-staff README · 用法：| 场景 | 这么打 |
|---|---|
| 快速第二意见 | `/agy-ask 你们后端是什么模型` |
| 通用任务 | `/agy-staffer 总结这个仓库里的 TODO` |
| 生成图片 | `/agy-staffer 画个像素风机器人吉祥物，存到 assets/mascot.png` |
| 审当前工作区 | `/agy-reviewer 审一下当前工作区` |
| 审 PR | `/agy-reviewer 审一下 PR #12` |
| 挑战方案 | `/agy-reviewer 挑一下 docs/plan.md 里迁移方案的问题` |
| 调研 | `/agy-researcher 这个仓库的鉴权是怎么走的` |
| 小范围实现 | `/agy-implementer 修掉那个不稳定的 retry 测试` |
| 编排一整件事 | `/agy-lead 调研几个方案，起草提案，然后按我的反馈改一版` |
| 任务管理 | `/agy-jobs`，或者直接说「agy 的任务好了吗」 |
dsh-agy-staff README · 用法：只有 `ask` 是阻塞的。其余都返回 job id，靠 companion 的 `wait` 收报告；在 dsh 里把那个 `wait` 当后台任务跑，宿主就能继续干活 —— 一个 job 只开一个 wait，`exit 2` 表示还在跑。

dsh-agy-staff README · 原理：- **一个 provider，七个 candidate。** `index.js` 解析随包的 `assets/skills/<persona>/SKILL.md` frontmatter，正文即技能内容，`rank: 600`（打包 provider 的优先级）。零依赖，只用 Node 内置模块。
- **名字前缀是硬需求。** dsh 没有冒号命名空间，只有名字以 `agy` 开头才会被 `/agy` 列出来。所以对外供的是 `agy-<persona>`，磁盘上的目录保留上游的 `ask`/`jobs` —— 这样正文里的 `../jobs/SKILL.md` 原样就能解析。
- **所有路径在喂给模型之前就解析完。** 上游写的是 `<skill-dir>/../../companion/agy-companion.mjs`，把解析留给宿主；在 dsh 里这句话读起来像谜语（"skill dir 是 assets\ask？"），于是每个新会话都要浪费一轮去 glob 找 companion、再浪费一轮纠错。现在 provider 把 `<skill-dir>`、`<plugin-root>`、`../jobs/…`、`../../companion/…`、`../../docs/…` 全部改写成绝对路径，并在正文最前面放一段"已解析，别去找"的说明。命令照抄就能跑，第一次就对，每次都对 —— 磁盘上的 vendored 文件不动。
- **`resourceBase` 仍然声明。** `{ kind: 'directory', path: <pkg>/assets }` 留作兜底：改写没覆盖到的引用（比如上游明天新加的）照样能解析。
- **`agy` 同时是子智能体。** `agy-subagent.js` 注册一个进程外的 `SubagentProvider`，bundle 再用 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent` 挂出 `provider: agy, toolName: agy` —— 模型可以把整件事直接派给 Antigravity 当一个子 agent，而不用自己拼 shell 命令、盯 job id。能力位一律声明 `false`（没有 `agentOptions`/`agentPreset`/`outputSchema`/深度限制），因为跨进程的子 agent 兑现不了这些，且不继承父会话上下文。环境变量：`DSH_AGY_SUBAGENT_MODE`（默认 `staffer`）、`DSH_AGY_SUBAGENT_TIMEOUT_MS`、`DSH_AGY_COMPANION`。
- **文案在加载时本地化。** 上游正文写的是 `/agy:ask`；p

dsh-agy-staff README · 控制面板：bundle 里带一个浏览器端小面板（`dsh.client` → `client.js`，注册进 `shell.overlay` 槽位）和一条给它喂数据的宿主路由：`POST /agy/api`。重启后输入框右侧上方会多一个圆形 **agy** 按钮。

| 面板区 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| 环境 | companion 路径（✓/✗）、`agy --version`、插件版本、配置文件路径 |
| 委派配置 | 模式（`staffer`/`research`/`review`/`implement`/`ask`）、推理强度（与模型 id 合成，不重复设置）、模型家族或自定义 id、单次委派超时 |
| 连通性测试 | 跑一次 `ask` 并显示耗时 —— 「agy 到底通不通」按钮 |
| 作业 | 从 `<cwd>/.agy-staff/state.json` 读最近作业，可**看结果**、可**取消** |

dsh-agy-staff README · 控制面板：保存的值每次委派都从 `<dshHome>/agy-staff/settings.json` 现读，所以**保存即时生效，不用重启**；只有 bundle 行（面板本身、工具、两个 provider）是应用启动时固定的。

路由只认同源：跨站在 `Origin`/`Sec-Fetch-Site` 上就被拒，且必须 `content-type: application/json` —— 随便哪个网页都没法通过回环地址驱动 agy。

dsh-agy-staff README · 更新：上游有更新：

```powershell
git -C <agy-staff-checkout> pull
node scripts/vendor-upstream.mjs --from <agy-staff-checkout>
npm test
```

然后重启应用。`scripts/vendor-upstream.mjs` 负责复制、重写 `assets/UPSTREAM-COMMIT`，并在上游删掉某个路径时给警告。

本 bundle 自身：

```powershell
git pull
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:$PWD"   # 换过位置就重新 link
```

dsh-agy-staff README · 排错：| 症状 | 原因 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| `/agy` 什么都不列 | bundle 行没加载 | 确认 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里有 `dsh-agy-staff`，然后重启应用 |
| 警告重复技能 `agy-ask` | 旧的"拷到 `~/.dsh/skills`"那套装法还在 | 删掉 `~/.dsh/skills/agy-*`（本 bundle 接管） |
| `unknown subcommand: researcher` | companion 的模式是 `research` / `review` / `implement` | 用模式名，不是技能目录名 |
| `ask` 卡住或 401 | agy 需要 localhost 端口和 OAuth token | 别在受限沙箱里跑；`agy` 先登录一次 |
| 技能正文里的相对路径 404 | `assets/` 被手工改坏了 | 重跑 `node scripts/vendor-upstream.mjs` |
| 重装后整个消失 | 行 id 变成了 pnpm 解析不了的包名 | `dsh plugin --profile desktop why dsh-agy-staff` |

dsh-agy-staff README · 鸣谢：**这个项目只是适配层，不是发明者。** 让这一切值得用的东西 —— 五个 personas、companion、任务协议、提示词，以及把它们量化出来的 bench —— 都属于 [**keli-wen**](https://github.com/keli-wen) 和 [agy-staff](https://github.com/keli-wen/agy-staff) 的贡献者。请去给上游点 star；你在用这个 bundle，用的其实是他们的工作。
